title: Keto Chicken Pie
description: A delicious keto twist on the classic British dish, featuring a buttery crust and creamy filling.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper. Bake in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, prepare the lightly mashed cauliflower. Steam the cauliflower florets until tender, then mash with butter and season to taste.
Roll out the pie crust and place in a 9-inch pie dish.
Fill the pie crust with the cooked chicken and mashed cauliflower.
Bake the pie in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
